dr-accurate-docs.summary: All documented API signatures, CLI commands, and changelog entries align with the embedded source. No drift detected.

issues.message: README documents createInvoice(customerId, currency) with two parameters, but current source requires a third parameter taxRegion (added in v2.0, required, no default).
README documents CLI command 'npx invoicer export-pdf' but export-pdf was removed in v2.0 and replaced by export-html.

dr-stale-readme.summary: Two errors: missing required parameter in documented signature and documented CLI command no longer exists.
